Protection | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
MDP relays are digital microprocessor based 
,non-directional over current relays that protect against phase to phase and 
phase to ground faults.
MDP relays performs the following functions:
Inverse over current including 
 four characteristic curves and four values for definite time .
Instantaneous over current protection with phase 
 and ground current measurement
Operating time and fault current of the last trip.
The first draft initiated & tested by eng. Elkassem Mohamed 
Elbendary, revised by eng. Abdel-Naser Moustafa Ahmed, accepted by eng. Shawky 
Attalla: general manager, approved by eng. Abdel Elmegeed Emara: head sector of SIDI KRIR 
Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Mona 
Ahmed Al Sharqawy: WDEPC consultant engineer A and MPIS coordinator.
